purpose: Choose one mechanism-independent deterministic Alpha158 cross-sectional state factor for Campaign291 without reading Alpha158 feature values, comparator values, daily prices or forward returns.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_session_median_state_consensus_strength_1d
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: A direction-agnostic same-session consensus score is deterministic, uses the already frozen Alpha158 design, and is mechanism-distinct from Campaign290's exact prior-session state persistence.

parameters.state_anchor: same-session finite model-support-peer median per coordinate
parameters.formula: absolute difference between above and below counts divided by all finite coordinate states

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_session_median_state_dispersion_1d
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: One minus the selected consensus strength is a deterministic inversion, not an independent mechanism; alternate direction search is forbidden.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_session_median_state_signed_majority_1d
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: A signed majority would treat heterogeneous Alpha158 coordinate orientations as a common economic direction; Campaign291 freezes the sign-agnostic magnitude only.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_session_peer_rank_extremity_breadth_1d
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Continuous percentile extremity introduces a separate rank-transform family; Campaign291 freezes the simpler exact median-state consensus mechanism.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_session_quantile_state_consensus_grid
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Tercile, quartile and quintile cut grids would create avoidable threshold multiplicity instead of one median-state trial.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_weighted_session_state_consensus
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Coordinate weighting would add arbitrary or return-fitted weights; all finite coordinates remain equal weight.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: campaign290_persistence_retune_or_combination
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign290's lag, support, formula, direction, costs and gates are terminal and cannot be rescued, inverted, thresholded or combined with Campaign291.

selected_formula.name: alpha158_session_median_state_consensus_strength_1d
selected_formula.formula: For each accepted signal session t and each of the frozen 158 Alpha158 coordinates j, compute the exact finite median m_tj over rows with model_support_eligible=true on t. For every quality_listing_eligible row i, require model_support_eligible=true and at least 119 finite coordinates. Encode each finite coordinate as -1 when x_tij<m_tj, 0 when x_tij=m_tj and +1 when x_tij>m_tj. Let B, E and A be the below, equal and above counts. Score abs(A-B)/(A+E+B). Do not use another session, fill, clip, smooth, weight, fit, threshold, sign or invert the score.
selected_formula.economic_hypothesis: A broad, sign-agnostic displacement of many technical coordinates to the same side of their peer medians may proxy for a coherent idiosyncratic technical state whose information diffuses slowly from the next open through the third close.

mechanism_separation.campaign290: No prior session, transition, equality persistence, suspension bridge or lagged state is used.
mechanism_separation.campaign103: Campaign103 counts directional day-over-day rank improvement over a 130-factor historical library; Campaign291 measures same-session sign-agnostic consensus over 158 Qlib technical coordinates.
mechanism_separation.signed_breadth_factors: Campaign291 takes the absolute above-minus-below imbalance because Alpha158 coordinate orientations are heterogeneous; no bullish or bearish common sign is asserted.
